6. In view of the above facts that the parties have amicably resolved their differences out of their own free will and without any coercion and also the fact that the present matter is a family matter,
rather the same would create further acrimony between them.
Hence, it would be in the interest of justice to quash the abovementioned FIR and the proceedings pursuant thereto.
Moreover, there is no legal impediment in quashing the FIR in question.

7. Accordingly, FIR bearing No. 965/2023, registered at Police Station Kalyanpuri, for offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), IPC and Section 6 of protection of Child Penal Code and Section 6 of Protection of Child Sexual Offences Act and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
